bind_address.description: IP address and port the server binds to. Use '0.0.0.0:port' for all IPv4 interfaces, or ':::port' for IPv6.

port.description: TCP port for game connections (ignored if port is included in bind_address).

password.description: Password required to join the server. Leave empty for public server.

rcon_password.description: Password for remote administration via RCON. Must be set to enable RCON.

server_name.description: Display name of the server shown in server browser.

motd.description: Message of the day shown to players on connect.

max_clients.description: Maximum number of players allowed on the server simultaneously.

max_clients_per_ip.description: Maximum number of connections allowed per IP address (to prevent abuse).

spectator_mode.description: Whether spectator mode is enabled (players can join as observers).

max_spectators.description: Maximum number of spectators allowed (requires spectator_mode = true).

game_type.description: Game mode: 'ddrace' (DDRace rules), 'ddnet' (DDNet rules), or 'standard' (classic Teeworlds).

map.description: Initial map to load (e.g., 'dm1'). Empty to use map_group or random map.

map_group.description: Map group (folder) to pull maps from when no map is specified (e.g., 'ddnet', 'race').

vote_enabled.description: Enable players to initiate votes (kick, map change, etc.).

vote_restart.description: Allow voting to restart the current map.

vote_spectator.description: Allow voting to change spectator mode.

vote_kick_timeout.description: Seconds after which a passed kick vote is executed.

map_change_interval.description: Seconds between automatic map changes (0 = manual only).

map_group_rotation_interval.description: Seconds between automatic map group rotations (0 = manual only).

log_file.description: Path to server log file (e.g., '/var/log/ddnet/server.log'). Empty disables file logging.

debug.description: Enable verbose debug logging (only for troubleshooting).

admins.description: List of admin accounts with optional IP restrictions.

name.description: Player name or client ID for admin access.

ip.description: Optional IP address (or subnet) to restrict admin access to a specific IP.

rate_limit.description: Maximum packets per second per client before rate-limiting kicks in (0 = disabled).

ipv6.description: Enable IPv6 support if the server and network support it.

ddnet_compat.description: Enable DDNet-specific gameplay features (e.g., double-jump, hook collisions).

allow_custom_skins.description: Allow players to upload custom skins to the server.

skins_dir.description: Directory where custom skins are stored (if allow_custom_skins is true).

ddrace_teams.description: Enable DDRace-style team play (teams of up to 8 players).

anti_flood.description: Minimum milliseconds between connections from the same IP to prevent spam/flood.

announce.description: Announce the server to the official DDNet master server list.

announce_master.description: Custom master server address for announcements (leave empty to use official list).

version.description: Override server version string (leave empty to auto-detect).

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (e.g., 'DE', 'JP') for server listing.

location.description: Human-readable server location for players (e.g., 'Frankfurt, Germany').

webadmin_tls.description: Enable HTTPS for the webadmin panel.

webadmin_port.description: Port for webadmin HTTP/HTTPS interface (0 = disabled).

webadmin_bind.description: IP address to bind the webadmin interface to (e.g., '127.0.0.1' for localhost only).
